'''Foli''' was a [[Nomai]] from [[the Vessel]] who went missing after the Vessel crashed on [[Dark Bramble]].<ref>KOUSA: We can hear the other escape pods’ distress signals, which gives me hope. Foli, are you still here?</ref> Their partner [[Kousa]] landed on [[Brittle Hollow]] with [[Escape Pods|Escape Pod 1]] and wondered whether Foli was still alive.<ref>Foli, are you still here? I am unsure how to survive in this place without you. KOUSA: (I am unsure how to be me without you.)</ref>

== Trivia ==

* Foli might be named after the ''[[Wikipedia:Caprifoliaceae|Caprifoliaceae]]'' or Honeysuckle family of flowering plants.
